profile_text: I am interested in language-conditioned robot manipulation, especially how vision-language-action models interpret ambiguous or underspecified natural language instructions and ground them into executable actions. I am NOT interested in pure reinforcement learning theory papers that have no robotic manipulation application.
exclusion: 로봇 응용이 없는 순수 RL 이론

profile_text: I follow sim-to-real transfer for legged robot locomotion: domain randomization, dynamics adaptation, and policies validated on real quadruped or humanoid hardware. Simulation-only results without any real-robot experiments are outside my interest.
exclusion: 실기기 검증이 전혀 없는 시뮬레이션 전용 연구

profile_text: My focus is robot learning from human demonstrations: imitation learning, teleoperation data collection, and scaling demonstration datasets for manipulation policies. I want to exclude classical motion planning and control papers that involve no learning component.
exclusion: 학습 요소가 없는 고전 모션 플래닝/제어

profile_text: I am interested in diffusion-based image editing and personalization: instruction-guided editing, subject-driven generation, and inversion techniques for real images. Text-to-video generation and GAN-only methods are not my interest.

I follow 3D perception for autonomous driving, particularly bird's-eye-view representation, occupancy prediction, and LiDAR-camera fusion. I am not interested in 2D-only detection benchmarks or downstream trajectory forecasting without a perception contribution.
exclusion: 2D 전용 검출, 인지 기여 없는 궤적 예측

profile_text: My interest is long-form video understanding with multimodal LLMs: video question answering, temporal grounding, and efficient frame selection for hour-long videos. Video generation or synthesis papers should be excluded even if they use similar architectures.

I am interested in 3D human motion generation from text or audio: text-to-motion diffusion, motion priors, and SMPL-based body representations. Facial animation and talking-head generation are outside my scope.

I am an ML engineer working on LLM serving infrastructure. I am interested in inference cost reduction: speculative decoding, KV cache compression, and post-training quantization. I am NOT interested in pretraining scaling laws or training-time efficiency, only inference-time methods.
exclusion: 사전학습 스케일링/학습 단계 효율화 (추론 단계만 관심)

profile_text: I build retrieval-augmented generation systems. I am interested in citation grounding, hallucination detection and mitigation, and how retrieval quality affects generation factuality. Pure information-retrieval ranking papers without any generation component are excluded.
exclusion: 생성 요소가 없는 순수 IR 랭킹 연구

profile_text: I am a developer building LLM agents that use external tools: function calling, multi-agent collaboration, and planning for multi-step tasks. Game-playing RL agents and embodied robotic agents are not my interest; I focus on software/API environments.
exclusion: 게임 RL 에이전트, embodied 로봇 에이전트 (소프트웨어/API 환경만)

profile_text: I design evaluation for LLM systems. I am interested in LLM-as-a-judge reliability and biases, benchmark design and contamination detection, and human preference evaluation protocols.
